usedFor: A new ActiveCampaign contact gets their own coupon in WooCommerce.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign, then “Create Coupon” in WooCommerce
bestTemplate.why: The trigger is pushed, so the coupon exists in the store before anyone is told.

watchOut: “Create Coupon” makes a new coupon on every run, so for one shared code, create it by hand.
